_comment: Canonical vCard specification, shared by two implementations: this app's
encoder (frontend/utils/vcard.ts) and the wallet pass service's Go one.
The implementations live in different repos, so this file is duplicated:
one copy beside each suite. Edit both or the encoders diverge silently.
Expected values are hand-derived from RFC 2426 and frontend/utils/vcard.ts,
never regenerated from an implementation — that would make the fixture agree
with a bug. Escape order is backslash, semicolon, comma, then newlines.

cases.name: full — every optional field present
cases.expected:
BEGIN:VCARD
VERSION:3.0
N:Doe;Jane;;;
FN:Jane Doe
ORG:WSO2 LLC;Platform
TITLE:Software Engineer
EMAIL;TYPE=INTERNET,WORK:jane.doe@wso2.com
TEL;TYPE=WORK,VOICE:+94112345678
TEL;TYPE=CELL,VOICE:+94771234567
URL:https://wso2.com
ADR;TYPE=WORK:;;20 Palm Grove\, Colombo 03\, Sri Lanka;;;;
END:VCARD

cases.name: minimal — every optional field absent
cases.expected:
BEGIN:VCARD
VERSION:3.0
N:Doe;Jane;;;
FN:Jane Doe
ORG:WSO2 LLC
EMAIL;TYPE=INTERNET,WORK:jane.doe@wso2.com
URL:https://wso2.com
END:VCARD

cases.name: whitespace-only optionals are absent, not empty
cases.expected:
BEGIN:VCARD
VERSION:3.0
N:Doe;Jane;;;
FN:Jane Doe
ORG:WSO2 LLC
EMAIL;TYPE=INTERNET,WORK:jane.doe@wso2.com
URL:https://wso2.com
END:VCARD

cases.name: shape of a real signed pass — comma in department and address

input.address: 10900 Stonelake Blvd Bldg 2 Ste 100, Austin, TX, US

cases.expected:
BEGIN:VCARD
VERSION:3.0
N:Doe;Jane;;;
FN:Jane Doe
ORG:WSO2 LLC;Customer Success\, Sri Lanka
TITLE:Senior Customer Success Engineer
EMAIL;TYPE=INTERNET,WORK:jane.doe@wso2.com
URL:https://wso2.com
ADR;TYPE=WORK:;;10900 Stonelake Blvd Bldg 2 Ste 100\, Austin\, TX\, US;;;;
END:VCARD

cases.name: escape order — backslash before semicolon before comma
cases.expected:
BEGIN:VCARD
VERSION:3.0
N:Doe;Jane;;;
FN:Jane Doe
ORG:WSO2\, LLC;R&D\; Platform\\Alpha\, Team
EMAIL;TYPE=INTERNET,WORK:jane.doe@wso2.com
URL:https://wso2.com
END:VCARD

cases.name: CRLF, CR and LF all collapse to a literal backslash-n

input.address:
20 Palm Grove
Colombo 03
Sri LankaLK

cases.expected:
BEGIN:VCARD
VERSION:3.0
N:Doe;Jane;;;
FN:Jane Doe
ORG:WSO2 LLC
EMAIL;TYPE=INTERNET,WORK:jane.doe@wso2.com
URL:https://wso2.com
ADR;TYPE=WORK:;;20 Palm Grove\nColombo 03\nSri Lanka\nLK;;;;
END:VCARD
